explication: OSV-SCALIBR is an extensible software-composition-analysis library. Its principal workflow configures and runs a scan over filesystem or container inputs, extracts inventory, detects vulnerabilities, optionally enriches and annotates findings, and returns scan results; results can also be converted to SPDX. A separate guided-remediation capability proposes upgrade patches for transitive vulnerabilities. The README documents these capabilities and the scan workflow; sampled source was limited, so internal wiring beyond that documented flow is not asserted.
